scope: Model/editor text and pedagogy pass for the owner-authorized Lessons 0014–0020 extension; not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: 'Room one or room two?', 'What time?', and 'Room two. At seven.' are natural concise confirmations when the event context is already established.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every Persian title, instruction, turn translation, prompt and option explanation against the intended English meaning; wording stays simple and avoids forbidden Arabic orthographic forms.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: No new core vocabulary is added; the Lesson deliberately combines two previously learned information types.

distractorQuality.evidence: The listening task changes both room and time, while the response task contrasts room, time and day answers.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Nina and Iris return after six Lesson positions and continue the community-center arc with a new program detail check.

difficultyFit.evidence: The Lesson is cumulative rather than additive, so cognitive load comes from recombination, not new vocabulary.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Room and time language returns after delay and is recombined in one final hidden-answer response.

transferQuality.evidence: The final response combines room-number language from Lesson 14 with clock-time language from Lesson 16.

overallCoherence.evidence: The entire Lesson serves one cumulative job: understand and relay a room number plus a time.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static content-flow review only: prompts, explicit help and per-option feedback reduce dead ends, but no real learner, microphone, timing or perception test has been performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual or prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
